name: Hierarchical Spherical Harmonics Optimization
definition: An optimization strategy that trains the scene representation by iterating through Spherical Harmonics (SH) bands from a starting band up to a target band, initializing parameters for each band sequentially.
summary: Hierarchical Spherical Harmonics Optimization is a training strategy that sequentially refines scene representations by optimizing SH coefficients from low to high frequencies, stabilizing low-frequency details before introducing higher-frequency ones.
